subject: general
question: Torgya, is a _______ day long monastic festival celebrated by the Monpa tribe of Arunachal Pradesh.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Three**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The 3-day traditional Torgya Festival of the Monpa community in Arunachal Pradesh was held in Jan'22.
 
• It was held at the Tawang Monastery.
